object.attr: analysis: an issue holds only committed files, and an agent that forgot to commit would issue the old text while believing the edit is in. Only without a commit, since an older commit can't hold the change (review Q13, CF-V36); shall (review).
object.description: When `tag_issue` is given no commit and the document has an uncommitted change, the MCP server shall refuse the issue and name the changed files.
